defaultPrompt: Create a Chat Tree from our plan.

interface.longDescription: Turn an agreed plan into a nested checklist where every item is its own Codex chat. Item chats inherit the settings of their immediate parent, and completing a branch collects summaries bottom-up and hands the result to its parent.

description: Nested task checklists, shared context and linked Codex chats.
